annotations.title: Latest news, guides, reviews and deals

description: Return getcheapgames' latest editorial posts, newest first: news, buying guides, reviews, deals roundups and videos. Use it for gaming news or the site's articles; for prices use search_games or get_game_offers. `tag` keeps one kind, and `query` keeps posts whose title or summary contains its words, ignoring case, among the newest 48; both combine. `country` picks the language, a post's translation where it has one and English otherwise; `limit` returns 1-12 (default 5), and none found gives an empty list.

country.description: Two-letter market code, any case, e.g. de, gb, us, br or pl (40 markets). It decides the currency prices come back in, which keys count as region-locked, and the market every link opens in. Omitted or unsupported codes fall back to ie (Ireland, euro).

query.description: Words to find in a post's title or summary, e.g. "GTA 6".

tag.description: Only posts of this kind: news, guide, review, deals or video.
